main_text.p: metam nostram fuerimus assecuti, si da-tum ea pressius quàm factum antè urgere, liberare ab exceptionibus variis & instan-tiis, fœnerare subinde lucem dubiis quibusdam & obscuris, demonstrare suum illis inesse pondus idquè maximum, explere forte animum lectoris æqui & attenti, & viam sternere ad pleniorem sufioremque, & quâ his ipsis lux major affulgeat, ἀπόδειξιν[?] deinceps instituendam.
main_text.head: CAPUT VI.

head.i: Transitur ad testimonium Veterum. Et primò Græcæ Antiquitatis. Universa Paulo Epistolam adscribit. Triginta & amplius Græcorū testimonia. Singula juxtà seriem temporum & ætatum. Varia expenduntur, illustrantur. Hieronymi de Græcorum omnium consensu assertio. Exceptiones I. Cameronis discussæ, & enervatæ.

main_text.p: I. A testimonio divino, ad humanum ex methodi nostrae instituto progredimur. Nosseque operæ pretium quid in hac causâ, historicâ sanè & facti, vel om-nes[?]

page.notes: The word after "om-" is cut off at the foot of the page; the catchword "neca[?]" is doubtful. The Greek word "ἀπόδειξιν" is read with uncertainty in its accents. Dark specks and stains around the text are not printed. The running head's final letters are doubtful. Printed "s" forms are rendered as s.
